html:
Quest Giver: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and find Chilly Nelson's hat.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: It's the Wolves

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and find Chilly Nelson's hat.

Offer:

A snowman's hat fit for a Mage!

Turn-in:

You know what? I never really liked Chilly that much anyway. He always smelled funny. You can keep the hat.

Objectives:

  • A Pristine Snowman's Hat ×1

Client level range: 5–?
